description: Header file defining world query functions for the game 'Unvanquished', including entity linking, tracing, and visibility checks.

methods.name: G_CM_ClearWorld
methods.description: Clears or resets the world state.

methods.name: G_CM_UnlinkEntity
methods.description: Unlinks an entity from the world, called before removing or moving an entity.

methods.name: G_CM_LinkEntity
methods.description: Links an entity into the world, called after loading or moving an entity.

methods.name: G_CM_ClipHandleForEntity
methods.description: Returns the clip handle for a given entity.

methods.name: G_CM_SectorList_f
methods.description: Outputs a list of sectors in the world.

methods.name: G_CM_AreaEntities
methods.description: Returns entities within a specified area.

methods.name: G_CM_PointContents
methods.description: Returns contents at a point in space.

methods.name: G_CM_Trace
methods.description: Performs a collision trace in the world.

methods.name: G_Trace2
methods.description: Performs an alternative collision trace with different start solid semantics.

methods.name: G_CM_inPVS
methods.description: Checks if two points are in potentially visible set (PVS).

methods.name: G_CM_AdjustAreaPortalState
methods.description: Adjusts the state of an area portal (open/close).

methods.name: G_CM_EntityContact
methods.description: Checks contact between an entity and a bounding box.

methods.name: G_CM_SetBrushModel
methods.description: Sets the brush model for an entity.
